generated_from.policy: Original condensed operational records; primary articles remain the private source of truth.

title.zh: 页账、Android 分类账与运行时堆账不能直接相加
title.en: Page, Android category, and runtime heap ledgers are not directly additive

summary.zh: PSS/RSS/Private Dirty/SwapPss 描述页成本，App Summary 是 Android 对页账与 memtrack 的分类，Heap Size/Alloc/Free 与 HPROF 描述运行时或对象图。分析必须先标明账本，再比较同口径、同时间窗的数据。
summary.en: PSS, RSS, Private Dirty, and SwapPss describe page cost; App Summary classifies page and memtrack data; Heap Size/Alloc/Free and HPROF describe runtime or object-graph state. Label the ledger before comparing matching samples.

does_not_prove.zh: 单个 Heap Alloc、HPROF retained size 或 PSS 数字不能独立证明总物理内存、泄漏 owner 或可回收量。
does_not_prove.en: A Heap Alloc, HPROF retained-size, or PSS value alone does not prove total physical memory, leak ownership, or reclaimable bytes.

version_scope.baseline: Android 17 / API 37, android-17.0.0_r1; concepts also apply earlier with field and formula checks
version_scope.caveat: App Summary formulas, memtrack categories, and printed fields vary by Android release and vendor.

title.zh: 设备、版本、进程、场景与时间窗是证据的一部分
title.en: Device, version, process, scenario, and time window are part of the evidence

summary.zh: 每个现场至少记录 package/PID、API、build fingerprint、页大小、采集时间、场景 phase、复现轮次、冷却时间和工具开关。缺少这些字段时，跨设备、跨版本与前后对比必须降级。
summary.en: Record package/PID, API level, build fingerprint, page size, timestamp, scenario phase, loops, cooldown, and tool switches. Missing context weakens cross-device, cross-version, and before/after comparisons.

does_not_prove.zh: 仅写“Android 17”或设备型号不能证明内核、ROM 策略、页大小和 WebView/provider 实现一致。
does_not_prove.en: An Android version or device model alone does not prove matching kernel, ROM policy, page size, or WebView/provider behavior.

version_scope.caveat: 16 KB base-page devices and OEM memory policies make context especially important.

title.zh: 采集工具会改写被观察现场
title.en: Collection tools can alter the observed state

summary.zh: 自然 phase 优先使用低扰动页账；详细 meminfo、HPROF、heapprofd 与强制 GC 进入独立 diagnostic phase。只有采集模式相同的样本才适合直接做趋势。
summary.en: Prefer low-perturbation page accounting for natural phases. Put detailed meminfo, HPROF, heapprofd, and forced GC in diagnostic phases. Compare trends only across matching collection modes.

does_not_prove.zh: 强制 GC 后的对象图不能代表自然峰值，诊断期间的帧时间也不能用于用户体验验收。
does_not_prove.en: A post-forced-GC object graph is not a natural peak, and frame time during invasive diagnostics is not UX validation evidence.

version_scope.caveat: Exact dumpsys behavior and profiler overhead depend on platform and tool version.

title.zh: Java 泄漏需要对象存活、强引用路径与可重复增长
title.en: Java leaks need object survival, a strong reference path, and repeatable growth

summary.zh: 类实例数或 retained size 只建立候选。可靠定位要绑定业务 owner、GC Root 强引用路径、生命周期预期和多轮 before/after/cooldown 证据。
summary.en: Class counts or retained size only create candidates. Reliable attribution binds the business owner, GC-root path, lifecycle expectation, and repeated before/after/cooldown evidence.

does_not_prove.zh: 对象很多、对象很大或从 GC Root 可达都不自动等于泄漏；必须先定义该对象在场景结束后是否应释放。
does_not_prove.en: Many objects, large objects, or GC-root reachability do not automatically mean a leak; first define whether the object should be gone after the scenario.

version_scope.baseline: ART-era Android; HPROF format and profiler APIs are tool/version sensitive
version_scope.caveat: HPROF describes managed objects and selected native wrappers, not all process pages.

title.zh: Native 页增长与 Native 分配 owner 是两层证据
title.en: Native page growth and native allocation ownership are separate evidence layers

summary.zh: meminfo/smaps/showmap 能确认 Native/Scudo/匿名映射成本与走势；具体调用方需要 heapprofd、malloc_debug、GWP-ASan/MTE/HWASan 或业务分配追踪。DirectByteBuffer 的 Java wrapper 只解释一部分 native 生命周期。
summary.en: meminfo, smaps, and showmap establish Native/Scudo/anonymous mapping cost and trend. Ownership needs heapprofd, malloc_debug, GWP-ASan/MTE/HWASan, or app allocation tracing. A DirectByteBuffer wrapper explains only part of native lifetime.

does_not_prove.zh: 一个 `[anon:scudo:*]` 大映射不能证明是哪段 C/C++ 代码分配，也不能证明这些页不可复用。
does_not_prove.en: A large `[anon:scudo:*]` mapping does not identify the allocating C/C++ callsite or prove that allocator pages are unusable.

version_scope.baseline: Android 10+ for heapprofd; Android 17 allocator mappings used as the current source baseline
version_scope.caveat: Allocator, sanitizer, and mapping names vary by Android release, ABI, and vendor.

title.zh: Graphics/WebView/IPC 内存跨进程、跨 owner、跨账本
title.en: Graphics, WebView, and IPC memory crosses processes, owners, and ledgers

summary.zh: Graphics 可能同时出现在 memtrack、Gfx dev、DMA-BUF、SurfaceFlinger、WebView renderer 和 Java wrapper。先确认 buffer owner、进程模型和计费口径，再讨论纹理、Bitmap、Surface 或 WebView 优化。
summary.en: Graphics can appear through memtrack, Gfx dev, DMA-BUF, SurfaceFlinger, WebView renderers, and Java wrappers. Establish buffer ownership, process model, and accounting before proposing Bitmap, texture, Surface, or WebView changes.

does_not_prove.zh: Java Bitmap 数量或 Graphics App Summary 单项不能独立证明 GPU/Surface/DMA-BUF owner，也不能安全相加为总显存。
does_not_prove.en: Java Bitmap counts or a Graphics App Summary value alone do not identify GPU, Surface, or DMA-BUF owners and cannot be safely summed as total GPU memory.

version_scope.caveat: GPU drivers, memtrack HALs, WebView providers, and OEM debugfs access vary widely.

title.zh: 整机低内存是 reclaim、swap、stall 与 kill 的时间链
title.en: System low memory is a timeline of reclaim, swap, stalls, and kills

summary.zh: 系统压力分析应把 `/proc/meminfo`、PSI、ZRAM/swap、调度/Perfetto、LMKD/exit 事件放进同一窗口。App PSS 高可以是候选成本，但不能独立证明整机压力或 kill 原因。
summary.en: System-pressure analysis aligns `/proc/meminfo`, PSI, ZRAM/swap, scheduling/Perfetto, and LMKD/exit events. High app PSS may be a cost candidate but does not independently prove pressure or kill cause.

does_not_prove.zh: 单点 MemAvailable、单个 SwapPss 或一次进程消失不能区分 reclaim 抖动、LMKD、OOM、memory limiter、用户操作或崩溃。
does_not_prove.en: A MemAvailable snapshot, SwapPss value, or missing process cannot distinguish reclaim thrash, LMKD, OOM, memory limiter, user action, or crash.

version_scope.baseline: PSI-based LMKD is common on Android 10+; Android 17 sources are the current reference
version_scope.caveat: OEM thresholds, kernel features, low-RAM mode, swap policy, and kill strategy vary.

title.zh: 退出原因是事件证据，不是死亡前精确内存快照
title.en: Exit reason is event evidence, not an exact pre-death memory snapshot

summary.zh: ApplicationExitInfo 可区分 low-memory、memory-limiter、ANR、crash、signal、freezer 等退出原因，并提供时间与最后采样 PSS/RSS；最后采样可能滞后或为零，必须与现场时间线对齐。
summary.en: ApplicationExitInfo distinguishes low-memory, memory-limiter, ANR, crash, signal, freezer, and other exits with timing and last sampled PSS/RSS. The sample can lag or be zero and must be aligned with the incident timeline.

does_not_prove.zh: `REASON_LOW_MEMORY` 不等于 App 泄漏，最后 RSS/PSS 也不等于 kill 瞬间的完整页账。
does_not_prove.en: `REASON_LOW_MEMORY` does not equal an app leak, and last RSS/PSS is not the complete page ledger at the kill instant.

version_scope.baseline: ApplicationExitInfo is API 30+; memory-limiter reason is Android 17/API 37
version_scope.caveat: Fields and reasons must be gated by API level and device behavior.

title.zh: 设备差异必须作为分析维度而不是噪声
title.en: Device variance is an analysis dimension, not noise

summary.zh: RAM 档、low-RAM 配置、页大小、SoC/GPU driver、WebView provider、UI runtime、OEM LMKD/freezer/swap 策略都会改变同一场景的页账与生存线。预算和阈值应按 bucket 建立并可回修。
summary.en: RAM class, low-RAM mode, page size, SoC/GPU driver, WebView provider, UI runtime, and OEM LMKD/freezer/swap policy change the same scenario's accounting and survival boundary. Build revisable budgets by device bucket.

does_not_prove.zh: 一台实验机上的绝对 MB 阈值不能直接推广为所有设备、ROM 和 UI runtime 的门禁。
does_not_prove.en: An absolute MB threshold from one lab device cannot become a universal gate across devices, ROMs, and UI runtimes.

version_scope.caveat: Bucket definitions are product-specific and must be refreshed from production evidence.

title.zh: 优化建议必须绑定预算、owner、机制与验收
title.en: Optimization advice must bind budget, owner, mechanism, and verification

summary.zh: 从证据确认增长的账本与 owner 后，再提出最小改动。修复计划要写清目标场景、预算、预期改变的指标、可能回归、before/after/cooldown 验收与回滚条件。
summary.en: After evidence identifies the growing ledger and owner, propose the smallest mechanism-aligned change. State scenario budget, expected metric change, regressions, before/after/cooldown validation, and rollback conditions.

does_not_prove.zh: “减少缓存”“改 SoftReference”“调用 recycle”或“主动 GC”等通用建议不证明适合当前 owner，也不证明用户体验会改善。
does_not_prove.en: Generic advice such as reducing caches, using SoftReference, recycling, or forcing GC does not prove fit for the current owner or improved UX.

version_scope.caveat: Lifecycle, cache, and resource-release semantics depend on the app architecture and library versions.

title.zh: HPROF 是高敏感、高扰动证据
title.en: HPROF is sensitive and highly perturbing evidence

summary.zh: 堆快照可能含 URL、token、用户输入、业务缓存和对象关系。采集前需要授权、体积/超时限制、安全存储、访问控制、留存与删除策略；AI 上下文默认只包含哈希、校验和结构化摘要。
summary.en: Heap snapshots can contain URLs, tokens, user input, business caches, and object relationships. Require authorization, size/time limits, secure storage, access controls, retention, and deletion; AI context defaults to hashes, validation, and structured summaries.

does_not_prove.zh: 压缩、改扩展名或删除可见字符串不自动构成完整脱敏，也不保证 HPROF 工具兼容。
does_not_prove.en: Compression, renaming, or deleting visible strings is not complete redaction and does not guarantee HPROF compatibility.

version_scope.baseline: All Android versions supporting heap dumps
version_scope.caveat: Production profiling permissions and privacy requirements depend on platform, app policy, and jurisdiction.

title.zh: Android 17 的 memory limiter 与 profiling trigger 需要版本门控
title.en: Android 17 memory-limiter and profiling triggers require version gating

summary.zh: Android 17 增加 memory-limiter 退出原因与 OOM/anomaly profiling trigger。诊断应在 API 37+ 使用这些信号，在更早版本明确标记不可用，并回退到 exit-info、Vitals、受控采样或实验室复现。
summary.en: Android 17 adds memory-limiter exit evidence and OOM/anomaly profiling triggers. Use them on API 37+, mark them unavailable earlier, and fall back to exit info, Vitals, controlled sampling, or lab reproduction.

does_not_prove.zh: 看到高 PSS 不等于触发 memory limiter；必须有平台退出原因、trigger 或对应系统事件。
does_not_prove.en: High PSS does not prove a memory-limiter event; platform exit reason, trigger, or matching system event is required.

version_scope.caveat: Do not project Android 17 runtime behavior or API constants onto older releases.
